title: Fire Trap
build: Triad crack, D64 (plain image), hand-over at $0900, trainer off

credits.role: graphics and music (second-hand, a retro blog)

accuracy.note: 44 hand-written and 16 template comments; 3 wrong and 18 with a wrong detail
in six chunks, one checker at a time, and every claim in facts.md (108 claims, 25 corrected); 385 comments wrong, 13 labels renamed
after the full audit; two were a label renamed in the audit and left in other comments, one a picture block's reader
after correcting the second sample; old label names and one game-table template; a sweep then replaced every stale name

exclude: runtime: the colour buffer that draw_screen fills (one byte per screen cell, 40 to a row) before the copy to colour RAM at $D800, and the screen the cracker's intro left at $0400; the image carries leftovers
runtime: the sprite list, 4 bytes (x, y, colour, pointer) for each sprite, counted by $4D; rebuilt every game tick
runtime: the stage map, ten columns by eighty rows from $0B00, which load_stage_map fills from $8E00-$9A7F; the rest is spare
runtime: the four bands of sprite records that sort_sprites builds every frame for the raster handlers
runtime: the building's character set, copied from $A6E0-$B6DF by set_tile_source at each stage; the image holds the one left from the last run
runtime: the first screen buffer of the double buffer and its sprite pointers, redrawn every tick
runtime: the second screen buffer of the double buffer and its sprite pointers, redrawn every tick

runtime: the text screen that the title, high-score and name-entry displays are built on and that the status panel at the bottom of the play screen uses; clear_screen and the screen builders rewrite it
